CustomProperties.Name: AllText
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Text shown when no item is selected

CustomProperties.Name: HasSelection
CustomProperties.Tooltip: True when at least one item is selected

CustomProperties.Name: InvalidCodes
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Pasted codes not found in Items

CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Normalized table with Id, Code, Display and SortOrder columns

CustomProperties.Name: SelectedCodesCRLF
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Selected codes separated by line break

CustomProperties.Name: SelectedDisplayCSV
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Selected display values separated by comma

Rules.InvariantScript:
SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        cmp_MultiSelectFilter.Items,
        IsBlank(txtMSF_Search.Text) ||
        StartsWith(Display, txtMSF_Search.Text) ||
        StartsWith(Code, txtMSF_Search.Text)
    ),
    "SortOrder",
    SortOrder.Ascending,
    "Display",
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

If(
    CountRows(varMSF_Selected) = 0 && CountRows(varMSF_Invalid) = 0,
    "",
    CountRows(varMSF_Selected) & " " & cmp_MultiSelectFilter.SelectedText &
    If(
        CountRows(varMSF_Invalid) > 0,
        " · " & CountRows(varMSF_Invalid) & " " & cmp_MultiSelectFilter.NotFoundText,
        ""
    )
)
